parameters.query:
WITH picked AS (
  SELECT measurement_key, destination
  FROM lean_lemur.measurement_deliveries
  WHERE status IN ('PENDING','RETRY')
    AND (next_attempt_at IS NULL OR next_attempt_at <= now())
  ORDER BY created_at
  LIMIT 20
  FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
)
UPDATE lean_lemur.measurement_deliveries d
SET status = 'PROCESSING',
    attempt_count = d.attempt_count + 1,
    last_attempt_at = now()
FROM picked p
WHERE d.measurement_key = p.measurement_key
  AND d.destination = p.destination
RETURNING
  d.measurement_key,
  d.destination,
  d.attempt_count,
  d.payload,
  (SELECT sm.weight_kg FROM lean_lemur.scale_measurements sm WHERE sm.measurement_key=d.measurement_key) AS weight_kg,
  (SELECT sm.bodyfat_pct_calculated FROM lean_lemur.scale_measurements sm WHERE sm.measurement_key=d.measurement_key) AS bodyfat_pct,
  (SELECT sm.measured_at_utc FROM lean_lemur.scale_measurements sm WHERE sm.measurement_key=d.measurement_key) AS measured_at_utc;

parameters.body: ={{ JSON.stringify({ performUpsert: { fieldsToMergeOn: ['Measurement ID'] }, records: [{ fields: { 'Measurement ID': $json.measurement_key, 'Measured At': $json.measured_at_utc, 'Weight kg': Number($json.weight_kg), 'Body Fat %': $json.bodyfat_pct == null ? null : Number($json.bodyfat_pct), 'Source': 'Eufy T9120 / openScale' } }] }) }}

parameters.query:
UPDATE lean_lemur.measurement_deliveries
SET
  status = CASE WHEN {{ $json.delivery_ok }} THEN 'DELIVERED' ELSE 'RETRY' END,
  delivered_at = CASE WHEN {{ $json.delivery_ok }} THEN now() ELSE delivered_at END,
  provider_record_id = COALESCE(
    {{ $json.provider_record_id ? "'" + $json.provider_record_id.replaceAll("'", "''") + "'" : "NULL" }},
    provider_record_id
  ),
  last_error = CASE WHEN {{ $json.delivery_ok }} THEN NULL
                    ELSE 'HTTP ' || {{ $json.provider_status_code }} || ': ' || '{{ ($json.provider_body || "").replaceAll("'", "''").slice(0,1500) }}' END,
  next_attempt_at = CASE WHEN {{ $json.delivery_ok }} THEN NULL
                         ELSE now() + (LEAST(attempt_count, 12) * interval '10 minutes') END
WHERE measurement_key='{{ $json.measurement_key }}'
  AND destination='{{ $json.destination }}'
RETURNING measurement_key, destination, status, attempt_count, delivered_at, last_error;

parameters.content: Airtable env vars: AIRTABLE_PAT, AIRTABLE_BASE_ID, AIRTABLE_WEIGHT_TABLE (optional). Table fields: Measurement ID, Measured At, Weight kg, Body Fat %, Source. Point IFTTT Airtable→iOS Health at this table. Fitbit uses a Generic OAuth2 credential named Fitbit OAuth2.
